## Goal and gate

Prove the owner-selected properties over explicit input boxes, calibrate uncertainty intervals,
compare coupled trajectories against Tier A physics and bind the guards to the certificates.
The brief requires CI to re-prove properties on surrogate changes. The owner certification
review is the human gate; it has not occurred.

The transport comparison uses final-state served faces with both temperature profiles
interpolated onto the same coordinates. It also reports whole-profile errors and cells with
both adjacent faces served. The final-state mask is not trajectory fallback accounting.
The owner prioritizes MAST-U remediation before further proofs and calibration ([OQ-25](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-25)).
Matched probes and an exact accepted-state replay diagnose flux errors and coefficient
rejections ([all 17 in-domain final-state probes succeed; on 12 served faces with reference flux above 1 gB, median relative errors are 41.17% Q_e and 74.27% Q_i; an unconstrained v3 control gives 38.05/71.88%]{.claim}[C-181](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-181){.cid .st-measured}, [all saved temperature, density and psi values are reproduced exactly; four final inner faces exceed the existing ion-diffusivity guard bound; 44.81% of accepted-state face diagnostics reject the surrogate]{.claim}[C-182](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-182){.cid .st-measured}).
